title: Content-addressed microfactor runner and rigorous dyadic affine rebase
problem: The table-backed shared-generator affine rail compiles below 1 GiB and materializes all 1792 coefficient entries, but a single 8x8 carrier propagation over t in [0,28] and a 64-panel reset factor both failed to return within their runtime gates. The measured exact rational center/linear bit lengths grow from about 968 bits after one panel to 7732 after eight and 61839 after 64. Eight-panel microfactors are therefore the correct execution grain, but a naive exact sequential join recreates the same denominator explosion. A rigorous dyadic affine rebase is required before the 224-factor join can be promoted.

requirements: preserve the same IvAffineCell generator across every chunk
serialize exact rational center and linear data plus outward interval remainder
hash every input and output handoff
fail closed on generator, shape, interval-containment or hash mismatch
compose chunks through certified affine apply/solve, never an explicit inverse

provide ivam_rebase_dyadic(a,bits), preserving the affine generator and shared epsilon while rounding center and linear entries to dyadic rationals and adding an outward enclosure of (C-Cq)+(L-Lq)[-1,1] to the interval remainder
refuse nonfinite endpoints, invalid bit depths, generator changes, or any hull-containment failure in the rebase
provide independent C/native gates, mutation tests, and an ASan-clean certificate for rebase enclosure and composition
support scheduled rebase after every four to eight microfactors and after a balanced ordered join
expose a small final rank and current-conservation join rail

does_not_establish: a mathematical obstruction in the Bach system
an endpoint flux or scattering theorem
